scope: Declarative buttons, read-only data blocks, progress rendering, typed form defaults, row actions and same-post background refresh
behavior: Button declares local sync or async behavior without hand-written Mattermost action payloads
each rendered Button action uses a one-shot token and rejects stale or repeated callbacks
DataBlock preserves static content when all local actions are absent or hidden
Progress renders determinate and indeterminate states with a textual numeric status
DialogRuntime.start returns a serializable DialogRef for a created post
DialogRuntime.update validates the active intent and edits the same post with rebuilt signed actions
monotonic revisions reject stale worker snapshots inside the persisted dialog transaction
CoalescingDialogUpdater retains the newest pending revision and flushes trailing or terminal state
typed form defaults resolve from Format, MagicFilter, sync or async getter data and are revalidated
ActionTable exposes bounded Blocks row actions without demo-local imperative rendering code
custom lowercase actions delegate to WidgetActionResult without runtime widget type branches
DialogRuntime.drain waits for deferred Blocks edits and surfaces delivery failures

capabilities.blocks_profile: exact container layout requires a proven Mattermost 11.11 or 12.x Blocks profile
capabilities.action_table: requires a proven Blocks profile and has no silent legacy fallback

checks.targeted_pytest: 39 passed, 3 skipped because a real Redis profile was not requested
checks.available_full_pytest: 486 passed, 23 Redis-profile skips, 303 subtests; three upstream-snapshot-dependent test files excluded because the sandbox cannot read their inputs

limits: The new progress scenario has not run against a live Mattermost server or native client.
CoalescingDialogUpdater is process-local; durable job state and distributed delivery remain application responsibilities.
